slides.title: Favourites
slides.html: Under Server configuration (admins), tap Favourites and pick a side. Tap a type to rename it, move it up or remove it.

slides.title: Add a type
slides.html: Scroll down and tap Add type. In Search symbols, type a name and tap the symbol you want.

slides.title: Usual targets
slides.html: Go back, tap Usual targets, then Add a line… and pick a unit, here 1J. Pick a feed or a role where its marks go, such as HQ.

slides.title: The usual target
slides.html: The new line 1J → HQ is 1J's usual target. Add a second line for its alternative.

slides.title: Feeds to follow
slides.html: Go back, tap Feeds to follow, then Add a line… and pick a unit. Pick a feed, or tap Another feed by name… and type it as Data Sync shows it.

slides.title: Stale time
slides.html: Under Enemy marks go stale after, pick from 6 h to 7 d. What you changed is outlined in blue or says 1 unpublished change until you publish.

slides.title: Plugin settings
slides.html: Plugins add their own settings here, such as Quotas and corridors from Drones. Pick Off for a unit without TOCs, and Drones then drops quotas, corridors and the TOC role.

slides.title: Publish
slides.html: Tap Publish… and confirm to replace everyone's setup on this TAK server. Each phone takes it when it next connects.
